isolation: unshare -rn (lo only); temporary HOME, XDG dirs and profile per browser, removed after the run; the user's profiles were not read
reproducibility: base protocol: two consecutive runs identical in 12 of 12 rows; CDP protocol: two consecutive runs identical in 6 of 6 rows
not_closed: Canvas, WebGL, fonts, audio, TLS were not measured.
Service and shared workers were not measured.
Q26/Q27 are the user's decisions in I15-R.T04.a.
findings_cdp: CDP over --remote-debugging-pipe with navigation after overrides gives consistent UA, Client Hints, language and timezone on the first request, window, worker and tab in Chrome and Brave. CDP alone exposes navigator.webdriver=true in window and tab (false in worker); --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled removes it everywhere.
